group: Message.getQuestion - null or empty question section

cases.description: The QUESTION section array entry is null. getQuestion() should return null.
The QUESTION section contains an empty List. getQuestion() should return null.

group: Message.getQuestion - returns first question record when multiple present

cases.description: A Message is created and two question records are added to the QUESTION section. getQuestion() should return the first added Record (example.com A) and ignore the second.

group: Message.getQuestion - returns null when first element in question list is null

cases.description: A Message is created, a null entry is inserted as the first element of the QUESTION list (followed by a valid Record). getQuestion() should return null because the first element retrieved from the list is null.

group: Message.getQuestion - throws NullPointerException when internal sections array is null

cases.description: A Message instance is constructed and its internal 'sections' field is manually set to null (using reflection). Invoking getQuestion() should propagate a NullPointerException because the method attempts to index into a null array.

group: Message.getQuestion - throws ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException when sections array is too short

cases.description: A Message instance is created and its internal 'sections' field is manually set (via reflection) to a new array of length 0. Invoking getQuestion() attempts to access sections[Section.QUESTION] (index 0) and therefore throws ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException.

group: Message.getQuestion - propagates exception from underlying list implementation

cases.description: A Message instance is created and its internal 'sections' array is set (via reflection) so that sections[Section.QUESTION] contains a custom List implementation whose get(0) method always throws IllegalStateException. Calling getQuestion() should propagate this IllegalStateException.
